name: Admin Secure Link Create
description: Admin creates a one-time secure link choosing a catalog type, internal title, validity and recipient language; required secret fields are validated server-side and the created URL is shown once with copy actions for the link and a suggested message. Supports Custom with an encrypted name and free text, validates required fields before sending, handles HTML failures without discarding content, retries catalog loading, and clears credentials for a new link. Client and project remain optional in the panel.
